day_shape: 62 items: Trump announces US escort of commercial vessels through Strait of Hormuz from Monday with Iran calling it a ceasefire violation, CENTCOM transfers 22 Tosca crew to Pakistan, IDF strikes Hezbollah in south Lebanon, heavy IRIB/Defa Press cycle from Bagheri presser, nothing from UK Parliament or OFAC.

threads.label: US Hormuz escort plan and Iranian response
threads.summary: Trump said on Truth Social the US would begin guiding commercial ships out of the Persian Gulf through the Strait of Hormuz from Monday, per Jerusalem Post. Iranian officials called the plan a ceasefire violation, and IRGC's Brigadier General Abdollahi said via Defa Press that Iran's armed forces would protect the strait's security.

threads.label: Tosca vessel crew transferred via Pakistan
threads.summary: Defa Press and IRIB, citing ABC News and CENTCOM, reported 22 crew members of the impounded Iranian ship Tosca were transferred to Pakistan for return to Tehran. Iran's foreign minister Araghchi discussed the matter with Pakistani counterpart Ishaq Dar.

threads.label: Bagheri weekly press briefing
threads.summary: Foreign Ministry spokesman Ismail Bagheri told reporters Iran received a US response via Pakistan and said the messages concerned ending the war, with enrichment claims dismissed as speculation. He said 184 students and 36 teachers had been killed in attacks including on a Minab school, and rejected US treaty conduct as obstructing diplomacy.

threads.label: South Lebanon strikes and Hezbollah
threads.summary: The IDF said its air force killed Hezbollah operatives in southern Lebanon transporting weapons near troops and recovered Kalashnikovs, machine guns and anti-tank missiles. A Hezbollah MP vowed to thwart Lebanon-Israel talks, per Times of Israel, while IRIB cited CNN on Hezbollah's use of fibre-optic guided drones.

threads.label: Iran nuclear talks and war framing
threads.summary: Times of Israel reported Trump nixed an Iran plan that would have ended the war within a month while deferring the nuclear issue. Khamenei's office posted that US bases in the Persian Gulf cannot ensure security, while Iran International reported open divisions among Iranian clerics over continued conflict.

threads.label: Iran domestic conditions and executions
threads.summary: Iran International reported a 65-day international internet disruption driving migration, and Jerusalem Post said Iran's healthcare system faces shortages, infectious disease and toxic Tehran air. Mizan reported Iran executed a man convicted in the 2022 killing of a security volunteer.

threads.label: CENTCOM regional posture
threads.summary: CENTCOM posted that Adm. Brad Cooper visited the guided-missile destroyer USS Milius on May 2 in support of what it described as US blockade operations against Iran. CENTCOM also publicised A-10 Thunderbolt II close-air-support deployments in its area of responsibility.

events.title_en: Japanese factory production drops in aftermath of war with Iran
events.summary_en: Japanese factory production drops in aftermath of war with Iran. Japan Times reported: Japanese factory production fell in March as war with Iran has dampened demand outlook. Simultaneously, rising energy and raw material costs stemming from the war with Iran have put severe pressure on manufacturers and caused production growth, orders and business confidence to slow. Industrial indices also show that input costs have reached their highest level in recent months and companies are acting with greater caution in hiring and investment.

events.title_en: New exchange rate for credit institutions announced
events.summary_en: New exchange rate for credit institutions announced. The Central Bank announced the exchange rate for foreign currency assets and liabilities of credit institutions to be applied in financial statements ending Esfand of 1404 as 156,876 tomans per euro and 136,235 tomans per dollar. The aforementioned rates, in accordance with accounting standards, are equivalent to the buy rate of transfers from Iran's currency and bullion exchange centre on 28/12/1404. As of the beginning of 1405, the exchange rate is equivalent to the buy rate of transfers from Iran's currency and bullion exchange centre for each currency on the financial reporting date.

events.title_en: CNN: Hezbollah has deployed a new and powerful weapon designed to evade Israeli detection
events.summary_en: CNN: Hezbollah has deployed a new and powerful weapon designed to evade Israeli detection. In the new round of clashes, Hezbollah has used a type of fibre-optic cable-guided drone which, due to direct connection with the operator, is immune to electronic warfare systems and jamming. These small, low-altitude drones are very difficult to track and can approach targets without detection. Experts warn that this type of weapon, due to difficulty in detection and engagement, could change the rules of war with Israel.

events.title_en: Three dead from Hanta virus outbreak on a cruise ship
events.summary_en: Three dead from Hanta virus outbreak on a cruise ship. Following the outbreak of an acute respiratory illness on a cruise ship in the Atlantic Ocean, at least three people have died and one is hospitalised in intensive care. The ship, which according to South African authorities has 150 passengers, was travelling from Argentina towards Cape Verde, or the Green Cape archipelago in the Atlantic Ocean. The World Health Organisation has stated that tests have confirmed at least one positive case of Hanta virus and there are at least five other suspected cases.

events.title_en: Students will be like mirrors, displaying the behaviour and words of their teachers
events.summary_en: Students will be like mirrors, displaying the behaviour and words of their teachers. Students and university students and seminary students who grow alongside every teacher will in the not-too-distant future put into practice the skills learnt and knowledge acquired, and perhaps in their character, behaviour and speech in all spheres from the warm circle of family to the workplace and street and alley, like a mirror, display the behaviour and words of their teachers. An excerpt from the Supreme Leader's message on the occasion of Workers' Day and Teachers' Day, 11 Ordibehesht 1405.

events.title_en: Inability of America's weak bases to ensure their own security and that of their allies
events.summary_en: Inability of America's weak bases to ensure their own security and that of their allies. Today, not only among world public opinion, but also for rulers of countries, it has become clear that the presence of American foreigners and their establishment in the Persian Gulf lands is the most important factor of insecurity in the region, and America's weak bases do not have the capacity to ensure their own security, let alone hope for America to ensure the security of the region's allies and America-sympathisers. An excerpt from the Supreme Leader's message on the occasion of Persian Gulf Day, 10 Ordibehesht 1405.
